title: [review] messaging.py:241: Unbounded receipts collection
description: The _receipts list in MessageReceiptsResource grows without limit on each POST request. Unlike _inbox which is trimmed to max_messages in deliver(), receipts are never pruned. An attacker can exhaust memory by repeatedly POSTing valid receipts. The CBOR validation limits per-request size (4KB) but not total accumulation. Add trimming similar to _inbox: `if len(self._receipts) > MAX: self._receipts = self._receipts[-MAX:]`
